relevance_note: Cohort study of IL-18 in PSTPIP1 mutation carriers that reports patients only at group level ("Twenty patients were found to bear heterozygous mutations in PSTPIP1"; Table 1 gives group counts), with per-patient data only in Supplemental Table 1, which is not in the document.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; no script transcription. Supplemental Table 1 (per-patient clinical, genetic and treatment data) is referenced but not included (the Supplementary Material section holds only the label 'tS1'), so no individual-level data are available. Table 1 gives only group counts and medians for PAPA (20) and PAPA-like (11) patients. Variants are given only as group counts (p.Ala230Thr 11/20, p.Glu250Gln 6/20) without attribution to identifiable people. Two patients with Hz/Hc-associated mutations are described jointly ('cytopenias, organomegaly'), and one 'patient bearing a PAMI-associated mutation' is mentioned with serum IL-18 'elevated similarly to other PAPA patients'; neither has sex, age, a printed variant or other individual detail, so I treated these as group-level mentions and created no person rows. Possible inconsistency: the Results say 'Two patients had ... mutations associated with the Hyperzincemia/hypercalprotectinemia (Hz/Hc) syndrome', while the Discussion says 'Serum was available from only one patient bearing a PAMI-associated mutation', although the Methods state that included patients had serum available. Cohort size recorded as the 31 patients referred for PAPA-like symptoms; FMF (n=18) and AIFEC (n=3) disease controls are additional and not counted there. The PSTPIP1 variants Arg405Cys and p.Gly258Ala in two PAPA-like/AID patients were classified benign by the authors and are out of scope. The study arose from samples assessed for an earlier MAS study (ref 7), but the paper does not state that any patient was described in that publication, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null.
